verdicts.reason: The two candidates use the same layout. The product bag fills the canvas width well, but in both the bottom third is mostly empty beside a gold circle that has been cropped at the corner, so the weight sits too high. A breaks the headline to leave 'fizz' alone on the second line, and the larger two-line block crowds the CTA, with only about 20px between them. B keeps the headline on one line with even space above and below, but it nearly runs into the side edges with only about 28px of margin.
